page_title: NEW 2-1 TOT | Newcastle v Tottenham Hotspur 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' The game has come to an end for Anthony Gordon. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
90+4' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90+1' Tottenham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
89' Timo Werner (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Substitution. Yves Bissouma walks off the pitch and Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.
82' The substitution has been made. Lucas Bergvall has replaced James Maddison (Tottenham).
82' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
78' 2 - 1 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Jacob Murphy. The score is 2:1.
77' Now Newcastle have a corner.
76' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
75' James Maddison (Tottenham) is about to take a corner kick.

75' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
74' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

74' James Maddison (Tottenham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top left corner, but Nick Pope easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timo Werner (Tottenham) replacing Wilson Odobert.
73' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
73' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
71' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) climbs highest inside the box and sends a poor header miles wide of the left post.
70' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

70' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham. Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
68' Substitution. Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) is replaced by Lewis Hall.
68' Here comes a substitution. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Sean Longstaff.
68' James Maddison (Tottenham) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.

66' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Guglielmo Vicario leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
64' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
64' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Tottenham will take a corner kick.

64' Tottenham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
61' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Harvey Barnes will be replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
60' Close! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
58' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Robert Jones pulls out a yellow card.
57' Tottenham get a corner.
57' The ball is cleared after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
56' 1 - 1 Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
55' Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
55' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
52' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
52' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece.
51' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
48' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
46' Half-time substitution. Ange Postecoglou decided to make a change. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is replaced by Brennan Johnson.
46' Robert Jones blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to feed Alexander Isak with a chip pass, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
45+2' Yellow card. Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
43' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) commits a foul and Robert Jones immediately signals a free kick.
41' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
41' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
40' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' 1 - 0 A goal! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) broke through the defence and struck a shot inside the right post.
36' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
33' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
32' Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.

32' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
31' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
31' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' It looked like the long-range shot by Pedro Porro (Tottenham) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
28' Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
27' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) steps up to send the ball in.

27' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
25' The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.

25' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
23' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
21' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
16' The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.

16' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.
15' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
14' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nick Pope intercepts the ball.
13' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
12' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
11' Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is adjudged offside.
9' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
8' Flag goes up against James Maddison (Tottenham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
6' OFF THE BAR! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
5' A cross from a corner kick by Newcastle is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
5' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Newcastle have a corner.
4' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
3' A pass from Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario and the move breaks down.
1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
